name: plugin.data_transformer
description: Multi-format data converter (JSON ↔ CSV ↔ YAML ↔ TOML), tabular filter, and statistical profiler

entrypoints.name: data_convert_format
entrypoints.description: Convert structured data between JSON, CSV, YAML, and TOML formats

entrypoints.name: data_filter_table
entrypoints.description: Filter, sort, and slice a list of dictionary records

entrypoints.name: data_summarize_stats
entrypoints.description: Compute statistical metrics (count, mean, min, max, nulls, unique count) for columns in tabular data

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: List of specific column names to analyze (default: all columns)

entrypoints.name: data_validate_schema
entrypoints.description: Validate a dictionary against expected types and required field schema

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Schema definition with required fields and types ({field: type_name})
